contract.temporal_denominator_definition: count of independent clusters in the partition

alternatives.sensitivity_to_cluster_size: largest/top-five metrics change directly with deduplicated members per cluster; symbol/temporal metrics change with cluster splitting or merging
alternatives.sensitivity_to_sample_size: percentages are discrete at 1/N cluster increments; N>=300 reduces but does not eliminate threshold granularity
alternatives.sensitivity_to_symbol_count: one cluster is fractionally divided across its distinct symbols, so attribution sums to one regardless of symbol count
alternatives.under_conservatism_risk: many singleton clusters can pass count-based gates while a small subset carries most economic return
